clue.text: Fair chance of drunkard turning to drink

indicators.note: turning signals that the word for the drunkard is read backwards

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard
to sup is to drink, taking small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: A heavy drinker's odds of switching to yet another drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' reverses SOT to TOS.
explanation.definitionFit: A toss-up is an even, fifty-fifty chance, like calling a coin flip.

clue.text: Around the early hours developed bother, PC needed something to go on

indicators.note: Around tells us the shuffled letters go round the hours abbreviation
developed signals that the letters of bother and PC are worked into a new order

parts.note: AM marks the hours after midnight, ante meridiem

explanation.surface: A police constable gets bothered in the small hours and needs something to rely on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'developed' makes CHBERPOT, which 'Around' wraps about the hours: the definition is a jokey nod to a pot one sits on.
explanation.definitionFit: A chamber pot is a bedroom vessel one literally sits on, a humorous reading of something to go on.

clue.text: One offering lift from Rue Paris

indicators.note: from here signals that the letters are drawn out of the street name and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone on a Paris street offering to give people a ride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' is a weak anagram signal: the letters of RUE PARIS rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: An upraiser is literally one who raises up, so someone giving a lift.

clue.text: Massive Asian points carried in anticipation of future sales?

indicators.note: carried in signals that the nationality and the points are placed inside the word for massive

parts.note: whopping means huge or massive
Indo- is the prefix for Indian, an Asian
W and S are the compass points west and south

explanation.surface: A huge haul of Asian compass bearings is somehow tied to forecasting sales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Massive' reads as describing the Asian, but it is the container word; 'carried in' splits it after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Window-shopping is browsing goods without buying, as if anticipating purchases one may make later.

clue.text: I'm stunned given less width wrongly installed — performance of cowboys

indicators.note: installed means the shuffled letters are set inside the exclamation

parts.note: wow is an exclamation of being stunned

indicators.note: wrongly signals that the letters of less width are put in a different order

explanation.surface: Someone is amazed to have been given a mis-fitted narrower piece during a rodeo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly' makes ILDWESTSH; 'installed' splits the exclamation after its first letter. 'I'm stunned' looks like a speaker, but it is the outer word.
explanation.definitionFit: A Wild West show was a touring spectacle of cowboy riding and shooting, made famous by Buffalo Bill.

clue.text: Local death of Ericsson broadcast

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered, so the letters of the company name are scattered

explanation.surface: A news item about a phone company going under, broadcast on air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' rearranges ERICSSON.
explanation.definitionFit: Necrosis is the death of cells in one localised part of the body.

clue.text: See 4
Fracas won't start with a scrap

indicators.note: won't start means the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: a fracas is a noisy brawl, a riot

explanation.surface: A brawl that doesn't quite kick off yields only a small fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'won't start' removes the R from RIOT to give IOT.
explanation.definitionFit: An iota is the tiniest amount, a mere scrap.

clue.text: Those confusing stories about right yew, wrong birds

indicators.note: about tells us the outer word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: garblers are people who confuse or distort stories

indicators.note: wrong signals that the letters of yew are rearranged

explanation.surface: People muddling tales about the correct tree and the wrong birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrong' makes EYW; 'about' has the storytellers' word split after its first letter. Grey warblers live in New Zealand.
explanation.definitionFit: Grey warblers are small songbirds of New Zealand, plain grey in plumage.

clue.text: Ravenous beast at sea swallows copper

indicators.note: swallows means the first word takes the metal symbol inside it

parts.note: at sea means confused or lost
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A hungry sea creature gulps down a penny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' looks like a location for the beast, but it is LOST.
explanation.definitionFit: Locusts swarm and strip crops bare, the very picture of a ravenous creature.

clue.text: Prepare for war with random timetable, one ignored

indicators.note: random signals the letters of timetable are jumbled
ignored means the letter for one is left out of the jumble

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Getting ready for battle with a chaotic schedule, missing one item.
explanation.walkthrough: TIMETABLE without I gives TMETABLE, which 'random' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: To embattle is to draw up an army ready for battle.

clue.text: Birds do keep getting in a flap with crows

indicators.note: getting in a flap means flustered, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Some birds keep panicking alongside crows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting in a flap' rearranges DOKEEP plus CROWS.
explanation.definitionFit: Woodpeckers are birds that drill into tree bark for insects.

clue.text: Transmission of heat from cold source of water heading off, lots here heading off

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

indicators.note: heading off means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a pond is a body of water one can draw from

indicators.note: heading off again means this word too loses its first letter

parts.note: an auction is where lots are sold

explanation.surface: Heat passing from a cold spring, with lots of things heading away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' twice removes P from POND and A from AUCTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Conduction is the transfer of heat directly through a material.

clue.text: Exotic location hot for Lennon's partner and singer

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps
Yoko Ono was John Lennon's wife
Lulu is a Scottish pop singer

explanation.surface: A steamy holiday spot for John Lennon's wife and a pop singer.
explanation.walkthrough: LULU is a Scottish singer famous since the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: Honolulu, Hawaii's capital, is a classic exotic Pacific destination.

clue.text: See 8
Set for lovers' quarrel during broadcast to be curtailed

indicators.note: during places the quarrel inside the shortened word
curtailed means having the tail cut off, so the last letter goes

parts.note: to send is to broadcast or transmit
a tiff is a small quarrel, typically between lovers

explanation.surface: A couple's row cut short in the middle of a transmission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be curtailed' leaves SEN; 'during' sets the quarrel inside it. 'Set' is a verb here, meaning to harden.
explanation.definitionFit: To set and to stiffen both mean becoming firm or rigid, as jelly does.

clue.text: With nose in the gutter, journalist's in business to grovel about

indicators.note: about tells us the word for grovel goes round the other pieces

parts.note: to fawn is to grovel or flatter

indicators.note: in places the journalist inside the business abbreviation

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a business
ED, short for editor, stands for a journalist

explanation.surface: A reporter in trade has to crawl around in the gutter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' gives CEDO; 'about' splits the grovelling word after its second letter. The definition is an adverbial phrase, like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying face down puts one's nose to the ground, as if in the gutter.

clue.text: Framework, so in design inconclusive

indicators.note: in places the word for so inside the shortened plan
inconclusive means without a conclusion, so the final letter goes

parts.note: a plan is a design
ergo is Latin for therefore, so

explanation.surface: An unfinished design for a structural frame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inconclusive' leaves PLA; 'in' sets the Latin word between its second and third letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A pergola is a garden framework of posts and beams for climbing plants.

clue.text: What could be subtler during search for weapon!

indicators.note: during places the jumble inside the search word

parts.note: to comb is to search thoroughly

indicators.note: What could be signals that the letters of subtler could be rearranged into something else

explanation.surface: A rhetorical puzzle about something subtler turning up in a search for arms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What could be' makes LUSTERB, the American spelling of lustre plus B; 'during' sets it after the first letter of the search word.
explanation.definitionFit: A cluster bomb is a munition scattering many small bomblets.

clue.text: Edit communist performance

parts.note: red is a common label for a communist
an act is a performance

explanation.surface: Censoring a show staged by a communist.
explanation.definitionFit: To redact is to edit a text, often by blacking out sensitive parts.

clue.text: See 4
Saddam — Iraq's Arabic leader in hiding?

indicators.note: in hiding signals letters concealed within the neighbouring words

explanation.surface: Wondering whether Saddam, leader of Iraq, is in hiding.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across saddAM IRaq's.
explanation.definitionFit: An amir, or emir, is an Arab ruler or commander.

clue.text: Don't sing a single song without heart — how much atmosphere's soaked up?

parts.note: to hum is to voice a tune without singing words
I is the Roman numeral one, a single

indicators.note: without heart means the middle letter is removed

parts.note: a ditty is a short simple song

explanation.surface: Instruction to hum a heartless tune, followed by a question about the air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without heart' takes one central T from DITTY.
explanation.definitionFit: Humidity is the measure of water vapour held in the air.

clue.text: Cite evidence to decapitate evil Mussolini

indicators.note: decapitate means take off the head, so the first letter goes

parts.note: bad means evil
Il Duce was the title Mussolini took as dictator

explanation.surface: Proof is offered to justify beheading the wicked Italian dictator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to decapitate' drops B from BAD; DUCE is Mussolini's title.
explanation.definitionFit: To adduce is to bring forward as evidence in an argument.

clue.text: Where time taken by cryptic crossword bum who's not hard

indicators.note: cryptic means puzzling, so the letters are mixed up
not here means the letter for hard is excluded from the mix

parts.note: who's stands for who is; the apostrophe s adds no letter
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A crossword-solving layabout who isn't tough is doing time.
explanation.walkthrough: Take H from CROSSWORD BUM WHO and 'cryptic' rearranges the rest. WORMWOOD SCRUBS is a well-known London prison.
explanation.definitionFit: Prisoners serve time in prison, and this is a London jail.

clue.text: See 24
